title: Interview Agent closings
description: Interview closings and farewell playback, from the interview agent's OpenTelemetry metrics. Every process exports cumulative series; each panel takes a series' last value in its window minus its last value before the window, and a series that is new in the window counts in full. Sparse interviews are counted exactly instead of being extrapolated or dropped, as rate() and increase() would do.

panels.title: Closings
panels.description: Interview closings, run by the worker or reconciled by the server. Closings reconciled by the server carry no interview dimensions, so the filters only narrow the closings run by the worker.

targets.expr: histogram_count(sum (((last_over_time(interview_agent_closing_playback_confirmed{source="", graph_version=~"$graph_version", language=~"$language", seniority=~"$seniority", length=~"$length", model=~"$model"}[$__range]) - last_over_time(interview_agent_closing_playback_confirmed{source="", graph_version=~"$graph_version", language=~"$language", seniority=~"$seniority", length=~"$length", model=~"$model"}[$__range] offset $__range)) or last_over_time(interview_agent_closing_playback_confirmed{source="", graph_version=~"$graph_version", language=~"$language", seniority=~"$seniority", length=~"$length", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) or ((last_over_time(interview_agent_closing_playback_confirmed{source="lifecycle_sweeper"}[$__range]) - last_over_time(interview_agent_closing_playback_confirmed{source="lifecycle_sweeper"}[$__range] offset $__range)) or last_over_time(interview_agent_closing_playback_confirmed{source="lifecycle_sweeper"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)
